subject: C02
performed_by: Claude Code driving the real fixture window through macOS Accessibility (tools/native-acceptance/ax.swift and System Events keystrokes) with fixture WebView self-capture; tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c02.py

checks.observation: after quit and relaunch: 'Prod EU (active)' with 'Scan key saved in the Keychain.': True; Dark appearance radio checked: True

checks.description: Profile import through the native open sheet attached to the main window: a synthetic airs-cli registry with an embedded synthetic secret and a credential-file reference previews names, TSG IDs and discarded-field counts, the secret appears nowhere in the AX tree, and importing creates keyless tenants.

checks.description: Locked credential store: with the fixture keychain locked through the app's own keychain reference (fixture-only menu), saving a scan key reports that the Keychain is locked, shows no OS prompt and falls back to nothing; after unlocking, saving succeeds and the retired record is cleaned up.
checks.observation: fixture keychain locked by the app's own SecKeychainLock (Fixture menu; `security show-keychain-info` then reports it locked): True; 'The Keychain is locked.' reported: True; no extra window or sheet (no prompt): True; Keychain items unchanged while locked: True; after the app unlocked its keychain (Fixture menu) the save succeeded: True; items ['cr-c707116219c431e3'] → ['cr-ed592bc802308599'] (retired record cleaned): True; another process's view after the unlock: unlocked=False (informational)

checks.description: Reset local data (two-step confirmation) removes the v2 tenants, preference document and every fixture-namespace Keychain item; v1 Application Support data is unchanged.
checks.observation: 'No tenants yet' after two-step reset: True; fixture-namespace items after reset []; state document present: False; v1 Application Support metadata (374 files: path, size, mtime) unchanged: True

checks.description: Corrupt local data: an unreadable state document is reported ('Local desktop data could not be read'), left byte-identical, creating a tenant is refused, and Reset recovers.
checks.observation: notice shown: True; Add tenant refused with the storage message: True; document byte-identical: True; recovered by Reset: True

checks.description: Keyboard and VoiceOver attributes of the tenant UI: Tab reaches the tenant form fields, storage-mode radios and actions in order; per-tenant actions are named ('Make … active', 'Delete …'); a refusal is exposed as an alert.
checks.observation: Tab reached ['AIRS API key', 'In the Keychain', 'Replace key', 'Change destination…', 'Make Prod EU active', 'Delete Prod EU', 'Label'] of ['AIRS API key', 'In the Keychain', 'Replace key', 'Change destination…', 'Make Prod EU active', 'Delete Prod EU', 'Label']; per-tenant named actions present: {'make_active': True, 'delete': True}; refusal message shown: True with AX alert roles [('AXGroup', 'AXApplicationAlert')]

checks.description: No internet sockets during startup with tenants and stored scan keys present (C02 makes no scan or validation request).
checks.observation: 0 internet sockets across 30 samples over 15s of the second launch (tenants and a stored Keychain key present) for the app and 3 new WebKit processes (0.5s polling; DNS via mDNSResponder not attributed).

checks.description: At 200% zoom and at the minimum window size the scan-key field and its Save action are reachable by Tab and lie inside the window, clear of the bottom fade.

limitations: The fixture build stores credentials in a dedicated fixture test keychain (DESIGN); the production login-keychain path is qualified by keychain_access (read-only availability) and, with signing, in C26.
Keychain items are inspected by attributes only (security dump-keychain without -d); stored secrets are never read back.
v1 isolation is evidenced by unchanged Application Support metadata (path, size, mtime); the login keychain is not enumerated.
Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names and focus are inspected.
Startup network evidence is sampled lsof output, not a packet capture.
That a referenced credential file is never opened is shown by the core tests and the absent file; file-system tracing was not recorded.

A trial run locked the fixture keychain from another process (`security lock-keychain`); the running app did not observe that lock and its writes still succeeded (macOS 27; retained under native-trial/). C02-N07 therefore locks through the app's own keychain reference (fixture-only menu item), which exercises the app's real locked-store path.
